description: Genuine legitimate demand spike (flash sale) -- NOT fraud. Specificity control: tests whether the system avoids blocking an innocent merchant having a good day.
note: The temporal layer flags this bucket as a volume anomaly, which is correct -- it genuinely is one. Specificity therefore cannot come from the volume signal, and does not: it comes from the downstream investigation agent, which aggregates device/IP reuse, mismatch rate and model confidence before deciding. See audit_trail.jsonl for the agent's ALLOW/REVIEW/BLOCK verdict on this event.
